interface.longDescription:
Circleback helps teams get the most out of every conversation with AI-powered meeting notes, action items, automations, and search.

Search and access data from in-person and online meetings you've recorded in Circleback, including meeting notes, action items, transcripts, people, and companies as well as your calendar and email.
